song.title: One Bourbon One Scotch One Beer

guitar.evidence: John Lee Hooker frequently played Gibson hollow-body electrics (ES-335) and Epiphones in his later career; well documented but not one singular iconic guitar.

tone.target: raw blues-electric amp grit with loose drive
tone.profile: raw blues-electric amp grit with loose drive
tone.summary: A simple, gritty blues chain using a low-gain boost/OD into a classic British or American small amp model, paired with minimal cab simulation for dry punch.
